name: Timemore Chestnut C3 ESP
details: Espresso-focused hand grinder counted in circles (rotations) from the start point (dial turned fully clockwise); 0.7 = 7 on the dial in the first circle. Timemore advises not to grind at the finest 0–0.4 circles.

rangeInfo.note: Timemore Chestnut C3 series manual (on ManualsLib), C3 ESP table: espresso 0.8–1.1 circles, pour over 1.4–2.0, French press 2.0–2.3. “For reference only.”
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: from the top of the espresso range to halfway to the top of the AeroPress range (or one AeroPress span finer when there's no espresso range); AeroPress: between the espresso and pour-over ranges (or one pour-over span finer when there's no espresso range); Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range; drip coffee maker: the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser. Dial in from there.
